nom: No7 Restore & Renew Face & Neck Multi Action Serum

segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report mixed results: one broke out badly across her chest and forehead, while others say it glides on smoothly, absorbs well, and works as a light, multitasking treatment for combination skin.
segments.oily: The one reviewer with an oily complexion says this thicker, lotion-like serum is heavier than the lighter serums she prefers and can leave her skin looking shiny, so she only uses it at night.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are sharply split: several report severe reactions, including facial and eye swelling, hives, itching, or a red rash within one to two uses, sometimes advising others with sensitive skin to patch-test first or avoid it; a similar number of other sensitive-skin reviewers, however, say it works beautifully for them with no irritation at all.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s, 60s, and 70s report firmer, less sagging skin on the face and especially the neck, with several specifically crediting it for improving a 'turkey neck' and calling it their favorite anti-aging product at their age.

concerns.aging: The great majority of reviewers report firmer, tighter, less saggy skin on the face and especially the neck, with visibly softened fine lines and wrinkles within one to four weeks of regular use, and several specifically praise it for improving a sagging 'turkey neck'; a smaller number, however, say it did nothing for their wrinkles or firmness even with consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the serum leaves skin feeling hydrated and moisturized, including one undergoing chemotherapy whose very dry, itchy skin improved noticeably, and none in this set report it drying their skin out.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers say the serum reduced blotchy, uneven-looking redness over time; several others, however, report the opposite, an allergic-type reaction with red, swollen, itchy skin or a rash appearing within a couple of days of first use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report a more even skin tone and fading of dark spots or discoloration with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers, including a mother-daughter pair, report the serum caused new breakouts across the chest and forehead badly enough to stop using it, and one limits herself to once a day or every other day in humid weather to avoid blemishes; others, however, say it has not caused any breakouts or irritation at all.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the serum as absorbing without a greasy residue, but the one reviewer with an oily complexion says the thicker, lotion-like texture leaves her skin looking shiny and oily, so she limits it to nighttime use.

aspects.libelle: Works well as a makeup base
A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: Was really looking forward to trying this product after I read the reviews. Tried it on my neck for 2days, I now have swelling, itching and hives all over my neck. I have sensitive skin and thought this may work since it states it is safe for sensitive skin. Maybe it is for some, it was not for me:( Just wanted to give a heads up to any one else who may also have sensitive skin who are thinking of trying this serum. Definitely do a spot test. Really grateful I did not apply in my face.

I wanted to like this. Nice to apply. But NOT suitable for my sensitive skin. Must have had some reaction to it because it broke my whole chest and forehead out in acne. One of the more negative and severe side effects I've gotten from trying new skincare. I am acne-prone and have combo skin. If nothing ever happens to your skin, maybe give it a go.

extraits.titre: The serum feels light and smooth.
extraits.texte: I like the feel of my skin after I apply the serum…soft and supple. I do not notice any reduction of lines and wrinkles or firming results.

I received No7 Restore and Renew Face & Neck Multi-Action Serum complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I have really started to like the No7 brand and it's products. This Multi-Action Face and Neck Serum has been a staple in my nighttime skin care regimen for the last 3 weeks. I like the fact that I get multiple benefits from a single product. As I age, I have noticed my skin losing the elasticity and firmness that it once had. The fine lines beginning around my eyes, forehead, and at my smile creases. My skin tone is not as uniform as it once was either. The years of UV damage and leaving my make up on overnight has definitely left its marks on my skin. But since I have been using Restore & Renew, my skin has become firmer, tighter, softer, and less blotchy looking. The fine lines around my eyes and smile lines are smoothing out and less visible than they used to be a month ago. My skin also feels very hydrated when I wake up in the morning and it lasts throughout my day. . The only thing that is a downfall for me is the thickness of the serum. It is thicker than my usual serums that I use. With having an oily complexion, I tend to gravitate to the lighter, more liquid serums. Restore & Renew Serum is more of a lotion type serum that is a little heavier on my skin and it leaves my skin looking shiny and oily. That is why I only use it at night. I am on my 3rd tube of this serum, and the 4th is in my linen closet for when I'm done with my 3rd. I bought this serum in Ulta when I finished my last tube of a discontinued serum. I had no idea if I would like it, but I needed a serum, so I thought, shy not give this a try. I've been hooked ever since. A little goes a long way, and it goes on like creamy silk. My skin looks smooth and refreshed, My neck has also shown improvement. I am 73 years old and have always taken care of my skin, and this product is certainly a keeper (I've tried many over the years). A little goes a long way, and Ulta has so many savings promotions, you can stock up and save a bundle.

extraits.titre: Definitely adding this to my skincare routine
extraits.texte: I was shocked to see this product do as much as it has. I have been receiving chemotherapy and my skin has been so very dry and itchy. This serum has not only hydrated my face and neck but made quite a noticeable difference and helped to heal a few spots. I would typically break out with new products, not see, or feel much difference and feel as if I've wasted my money. My deep lines have gotten much better and I've seen my face have more of a youthful glow and plumpness to it. I think it's important to note that I have quite a few neck and chest tattoos that also look much better. I love that it is lightweight and smells quite pleasant also. I very much recommend this product and will continue to use it!

I prefer a simple skincare routine, with multitasking products. My skin is sensitive & combination, & reactive to perimenopausal hormone changes. This product tackles several environmental & age related skin concerns in a light, fully absorbed serum. In the warmer months, I find that I don't need to layer an additional moisturizer. I received this product as part of a sample program, but will purchase another tube soon.
